claims.reasoning: Carnell Tate walked the plank off this very roster weeks ago and now he's walking right back on for ZERO dollars — that's not a waiver claim, baby, that's a redemption arc, and redemption arcs don't cost a thing. Jeremiyah Love's been dead weight on IR producing nothing but silence, and silence is the one thing I can't forgive.

Courtland Sutton's on a bye being invisible, which is the worst thing a man can do to me, so he's off this show. Audric Estime dropped FOURTEEN POINTS last week for free and I'm picking him up for the same price — a girl doesn't need a budget to upgrade a storyline.
